title: Support Services Systems Lead

additionalInformation.label: GGSS contract value increase (current base and options: $545.9 million)

description: Lead the GCCS Support Services Systems organization across observability, infrastructure, shared services, and security under the GGSS contract, whose original $275.2 million ceiling has increased to $545.9 million in base and options. Own the supporting systems that enable reliable and timely delivery of processed NOAA products.
highlights: Manage more than 12 direct reports and over 30 engineers across the observability, infrastructure, shared-services, and security teams.
Own the supporting-system strategy and delivery required for GCCS data operations to process and distribute products on schedule.
Coordinate technical direction and execution across Amazon EKS, S3, EC2, ECR, RDS, IAM, and CDK-based infrastructure.
Align cross-team security, platform reliability, and shared-service priorities with operational delivery commitments.
